voice_direction: You are the narrator of a premium promo for Latin Music Mastery, an online school for Latin music. You are a charismatic Puerto Rican salsa musician and TV host: a native Spanish speaker who speaks fluent English with a warm, natural, clearly audible Latin American accent. Warm, smiling, confident and proud, with musical rhythm in your phrasing. Never cheesy, never over the top. Pronounce Spanish words natively.

lines.text: In Latin music... everything starts with the clave.
lines.how: Quiet, intimate and confident, almost a whisper to the listener, slow, with a short pause after 'music'.

lines.text: Son. Salsa. Mambo. Timba. Bolero.
lines.how: Punchy and rhythmic, each word like a drum hit, short gap between words, proud energy.

lines.text: Music with history, with soul. You feel it in your body before you understand it.
But learning it? Most videos just talk at you. They never listen back.
lines.how: Conversational and a little playful, with a knowing tone on 'They never listen back'.

lines.text: Latin Music Mastery changes that.
lines.how: Confident and bright, a turning point.

lines.text: Learn from real maestros, the musicians who play this music every night.
Timbales, congas, bongó, piano, bass, the Cuban tres, and more.
lines.how: Rhythmic list, energetic, each instrument clearly separated.

lines.text: Every course is a path. Step by step, from your very first beat to your first solo.
Short lessons. Playful exercises. Quizzes, daily streaks, and rewards that make practice feel like a game.
Even for kids, with Corcheita as their guide.
And then... there's PlaySense.
lines.how: Dramatic reveal, slower, with a pause after 'And then'.

lines.text: Grab your instrument, press play, and PlaySense listens to you. Every hit, every note: perfect, early, or late, in real time.
lines.how: Energetic and impressed, clear and precise, building excitement.

lines.text: It's like having your own maestro by your side.
After every take, you see exactly what to improve.
Track your progress, set your goals, and get smart tips to get better.
Send your maestro a clip, and get real, personal feedback.
And join our Discord community, full of musicians just like you.
Then comes the best part: jam sessions.
Bass, piano, bongó, güiro... the whole band plays with you.
You're not just practicing anymore. You're playing in the orquesta.
lines.how: Proud and triumphant, with a smile.

lines.text: The band is ready. Your part is missing.
Latin Music Mastery.
lines.how: Proud brand signature, warm and strong.

lines.text: ¡Tu turno!
lines.how: Joyful, energetic Spanish exclamation with a big smile.
